choices.reasoning: Solid opening hand: a defensive Backflip, a threat-removal support, an ally with stun, a minion upgrade, and Aunt May healing. No weak cards to cycle out.
Play Aunt May, an alter-ego healing support, to set up 4-damage healing for later. I'll pay with the free Scientist resource.
Pay for Aunt May with the free Scientist mental resource, keeping all cards.
Surveillance Team is a key reusable threat remover for the 7-threat main scheme. I'll pay by discarding Spider-Tracer and Interrogation Room (no minion to attach/trigger them yet).
Discard Spider-Tracer and Interrogation Room to pay 2 for Surveillance Team, keeping Mockingbird and Backflip in hand.
No threat to remove yet and no resources left for more plays. Stay alter-ego to avoid attacks and build resources next turn.
I'm under hand size, so draw up to 6.
Switch to hero form to attack the guard Hydra Mercenary and to use For Justice!'s Hero Action (thwart) and Web-Shooter's hero resource.
Play For Justice! to remove threat from the main scheme (currently 3).
Discard Black Cat and Avengers Mansion to pay 2 for For Justice!. Scheme only has 3 threat so the mental bonus is moot; I keep Mockingbird, Web-Shooter, and Backflip.
Attack the guard Hydra Mercenary (2 damage, 3→1 HP) to progress defeating it and lift the guard restriction on Rhino.
Spider-Man is exhausted and I can't afford Mockingbird. End turn; the Hydra Mercenary is at 1 HP and I cleared the main scheme threat.
Under hero hand size (5), so draw up.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) which likely reduces Rhino's ATK 2 + boost to 0 or minimal damage, conserving Backflip.
Only 1 damage; conserve Backflip for a larger attack. I have 10 HP.
Cancel Gang-Up's When Revealed effects so the villain and engaged minion don't attack me again this phase.
Pay with the Energy resource card (2 energy, need 1) to avoid discarding a valuable card.
Play Mockingbird; she stuns Rhino on entry and I'll attack with her to kill the 1-HP guard Hydra Mercenary, removing the guard block.
Stun Rhino so it won't attack me this villain phase; I'll use Mockingbird's attack to kill the Hydra Mercenary instead.
Mockingbird attacks the Hydra Mercenary (1 damage, 1 HP left) to defeat it and remove the guard.
Guard minion defeated and Rhino stunned; no cards in hand and Spider-Man exhausted. Conserve the Surveillance Team counter and end turn.
Play Swinging Web Kick to deal 8 damage to Rhino, a major chunk of its 14 HP. I'll pay with Genius and Spider-Tracer.
Pay with Spider-Tracer (no minion to attach) and Genius (2 mental), keeping Webbed Up and Interrogation Room.
Basic attack Rhino for 2 damage (6→4 HP).
Mockingbird attacks Rhino for 1 damage (4→3 HP).
Remove 1 threat from the main scheme (3→2) for buffer.
Done for this turn; Rhino at 3 HP to finish next turn, scheme at 2 with buffer. Stay hero to attack.
Under hand size, draw up to 5.
Great Responsibility would convert 1 threat into 1 damage — not worth it for just 1 threat.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) to nullify Rhino's ATK 2 + boost; Mockingbird is at 1 HP so I don't want it defending.
Play Nick Fury (4 cost) to remove the new 2-ATK Shocker minion; Rhino at 3 HP I'll finish next turn with basic attack + Mockingbird at no card cost.
Discard Webbed Up, Interrogation Room, Great Responsibility, and Heroic Intuition to pay 4 for Nick Fury, keeping Web-Shooter for ongoing wild resources.
Deal 4 damage to defeat the Shocker minion.
Target Shocker to defeat it (4 damage, 3 HP).
Nick Fury attacks Rhino for 2 damage (3→1 HP), getting close to defeating stage 1; I'll finish it next turn with basic attack.
Remove 1 threat (3→2) for buffer; keep Mockingbird and let the 1-HP Rhino fall next turn with my ready basic attack.
Done for the turn. Rhino at 1 HP, scheme at 2, Mockingbird in reserve.
Under hand size, draw up to 5.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) to nullify Rhino's ATK 2 + boost.
Cancel Stampede to prevent a second Rhino attack and its stun; a stun would waste my next-turn basic attack that kills the 1-HP Rhino.
Use The Power of Justice resource card to pay, preserving my playable cards.
Play Web-Shooter for ongoing wild resources to help pay for the big damage cards I'll need for the multi-stage Rhino.
Discard Webbed Up to pay for Web-Shooter; keep Helicarrier and Heroic Intuition.
Remove 1 threat (3→2) with the last Surveillance Team counter.
Done. Scheme at 2; next turn basic attack kills the 1-HP Rhino.
Under hand size, draw up to 5.
Let the 1 per-round threat be placed; Great Responsibility's damage-for-threat is not worth it for just 1.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) against Rhino.
Play Jessica Jones (2 ATK) to defeat the 1-HP Rhino and advance to stage 2; keep Daredevil for the longer fight.
Pay with Web-Shooter's wild resource plus Helicarrier and Great Responsibility, keeping Heroic Intuition, For Justice!, and Daredevil.
Jessica Jones attacks Rhino (2 damage, 1 HP) to defeat stage 1 and advance to stage 2.
Stage 1 down, side scheme noted (hazard only). I'm confused and Spider-Man exhausted; end turn to set up next turn's attacks.
Under hand size, draw up to 5.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) against Rhino stage 2 (ATK 3 + boost).
Play Swinging Web Kick (8 damage) to fill the Armored Rhino Suit (5) and deal 3 to Rhino stage 2.
Pay with Web-Shooter's wild resource plus Heroic Intuition and Tenacity, keeping Haymaker, For Justice!, and Daredevil.
Jessica Jones attacks Rhino for 2 damage (15→13) now that the suit is gone.
Mockingbird attacks Rhino for 1 damage (13→12); she's at 1 HP anyway.
Rhino at 12 HP, suit cleared. Can't afford Daredevil and shouldn't burn For Justice! on confusion. End turn to continue grinding.
Under hand size, draw up to 5.
Jessica Jones is 1 HP and would die next round regardless; let her defend (absorb all, I take 0) so Spider-Man stays ready to attack and I stay at 5 HP.
No allies left; defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) to survive the second Rhino attack.
Use Surveillance Team to start removing threat from the main scheme (5/7) to create a buffer.
Discard For Justice! (confusion-blocked this turn) and Haymaker (tough blocks attacks this turn) to pay 2 for Surveillance Team, keeping Swinging Web Kick and First Aid.
Remove 1 threat from the main scheme (5→4).
Remove threat from the main scheme (5→4).
Heal 2 damage (2→4 HP) to stay alive before the next Rhino attack.
Use Web-Shooter's last counter (wild) to pay for First Aid, preserving my damage cards.
Change to Peter Parker to heal 4 with Aunt May (4→8 HP) and avoid damage next round, since I'd likely be defeated staying hero.
Heal 4 damage (4→8 HP) to be safe from damage while in alter-ego.
Play Daredevil to get 2 THW threat removal (main scheme 4→2) and clear Rhino's tough; essential to survive the scheme.
Daredevil thwarts the main scheme (4→2); his after-thwart effect clears Rhino's tough.
Remove 1 threat from the main scheme (5→4) to start keeping it below 7.
Remove 1 threat from the main scheme (5→4).
Daredevil thwarts the main scheme (4→2), giving a buffer for the next round's threat.
Deal 1 damage to Rhino to clear its tough, so my next-turn damage isn't blocked.
Switch to hero so Rhino/Vulture attack me instead of adding scheme threat; main scheme at 2 is safe. I'll use Daredevil to attack.
Stunned and confused make basic powers wasteful; end turn and plan next turn when ready.
At hero hand size (5); keep my defensive and setup cards, draw up.
Let the 2 threat be placed; I have Surveillance Team and Daredevil to remove threat next turn, and I'd rather conserve HP.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3); I'll use Backflip to prevent the damage, keeping Daredevil (1 HP) in reserve.
Play Backflip (free) to prevent the 2 damage, staying at 8 HP.
Take 3 damage (8→5 HP) to keep Daredevil, whose 2 THW is key to outpacing the scheme's 2/round growth.
Daredevil thwarts Crowd Control (2 threat) to defeat it and remove the Crisis icon, restoring my ability to remove threat from the main scheme.
Deal 1 damage to the Hydra Mercenary guard (3→2 HP) to work toward removing the guard block.
Remove 1 threat from the main scheme (4→3) with the last Surveillance Team counter.
Remove 1 threat from the main scheme (4→3).
Heal 2 damage (5→7 HP) to survive the next round's attacks.
Discard Great Responsibility (least useful) to pay for First Aid.
Healed to 7 HP, scheme at 3. End turn to draw fresh cards and clear the stun/confuse next turn.
Under hand size, draw up to 5.
Defend with Spider-Man (DEF 3) against Rhino.
